reason: The hypothesis directly restates the mechanism of severe lattice distortion leading to higher activation energy and dislocation pinning from P3 and P7, and the edge-dislocation control from P19, P21, and P24, applying it to the same alloy system (WTaTiVZr) already studied in P2, P3, P5, P7, and P29. The predicted outcome of improved ductility and toughness is a generic expectation from that mechanism, and the falsification test is taken from the methods of P6, P8, P9, and P30. The core idea is a restatement of reported results and proposed future work from the cited passages, with no substantive new element or synthesis.
copied_elements: severe lattice distortions from multi-principal elements (P3, P7)
higher activation energy for dislocation motion (P3, P7)
edge dislocation dominance in BCC HEAs (P19, P21, P24)
falsification test design (P6, P8, P9, P30)
